propositions: Add a narrow BindingStore.note_rich_emit(local_id, wire) operation that mutates rich-text convergence bindings through lifecycle→repository while maintaining hash, counter, and persisted-byte parity with the legacy in-place mutation sequence.

The new operation must NOT perform its own save on any path (changed, unchanged, or missing binding); it mutates the live binding and relies on the enclosing pass's unconditional save to persist, matching the current apply_handlers._observe_rich_reemit behavior.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal, returning a distinct None result that distinguishes them from changed/unchanged cases.

The operation must not expose direct repository or lifecycle mutation access to production adapters or reconciler callers; all_bindings() retains shallow copy semantics and all facade signatures remain unchanged.

Byte equivalence between new-operation and legacy-mutation paths is verified through a differential oracle test driving both sequences with identical stores and comparing persisted state after a single save.
